## How to use these blocks

Copy `presentations/starter.qmd` to a new file in `presentations/`. Keep its
`lcm-deck-revealjs` format, then replace or append slides using the blocks below.
Use the copy button on a code block and replace its example content.
Each block is **one slide**, not a complete deck or an interactive widget.

The starter currently demonstrates full canvas and feature + sidebar.
The hostile specimen demonstrates all six layouts. No CSS or JavaScript needs
to be copied into your deck.

[Back to presentation templates](index.html)

## Full canvas {#full-canvas}

One slot for a figure, live view, or focused argument.
[Preview this layout](specimen.html#/a-deliberately-long-title-must-wrap-without-asking-the-whole-browser-scene-to-shrink).

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
## One clear argument

::: {.lcm-layout-full-canvas}
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
Your text, figure, or live-view shortcode goes here.
:::
:::
```

## Balanced {#balanced}

Two equally sized slots for side-by-side evidence.
[Preview this layout](specimen.html#/balanced-evidence).

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
## Compare two alternatives

::: {.lcm-layout-balanced}
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
[Alternative A]{.lcm-panel-title}

First argument or figure.
:::
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
[Alternative B]{.lcm-panel-title}

Second argument or figure.
:::
:::
```

## Feature + sidebar {#feature-sidebar}

Two slots: a large working area and a narrower explanation or control panel.
[Preview this layout](specimen.html#/persistent-live-viewport).

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
## Explain a live result

::: {.lcm-layout-feature-sidebar}
::: {.lcm-slot}
{{< bonito route="/widgets/control-panel" title="Engineering controls" height="100%" public-url="/widgets/control-panel" >}}
:::
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
[INTERPRETATION]{.lc-eyebrow}

Explain the result, assumptions, and units here.
:::
:::
```

This block uses the existing control-panel widget as an example. A plain
figure or text can occupy the same slot. For distributed PDFs, set
`public-url` to the absolute URL of your deployed playground.

## Top split {#top-split}

Three slots: a full-width top band, then two columns.
[Preview this layout](specimen.html#/top-band-plus-two-supporting-regions).

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}

::: {.lcm-layout-top-split}

The main claim or overview figure.
:::
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
[Evidence A]{.lcm-panel-title}

First supporting result.
:::
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
[Evidence B]{.lcm-panel-title}

Second supporting result.
:::
:::
```
